mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with temperatures at 47 degrees. The Waxing Gibbous moon is out, and while the ISS is passing by tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Public Works department is reminding residents how to properly dispose of fats, oils, and greases to protect our sewer infrastructure. Also, the city has officially adopted the 2027 budget, which you can review on the city website.
There are no public events currently on the calendar for the next month, but we will be sure to update you as soon as new gatherings are announced.
In a recent police report, on November 2nd, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on West End Circle that resulted in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor at Culver's is Double Strawberry. If you are looking to stop by, the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
